description.p: One button, no accounts, no subscription and no traffic limits. NextVPN finds a route that works on your network and sends your traffic through it.
Одна кнопка, без регистрации, без подписки и без ограничений по трафику. NextVPN находит маршрут, который работает в вашей сети, и пускает через него ваш трафик.

ul.li: Choose the exit country, or let the engine pick the fastest
Выбор страны выхода или самая быстрая автоматически
Sends every program through the tunnel, DNS included, on any desktop or window manager
Пускает через туннель все программы, вместе с DNS, в любом окружении и оконном менеджере
Or only sets the GNOME and KDE system proxy, and restores yours afterwards
Или только включает системный прокси GNOME и KDE и потом возвращает ваш
Lives in the notification area and can start when you sign in
Живёт в области уведомлений и может запускаться при входе в систему
Light and dark style, follows the desktop
Светлая и тёмная тема, подстраивается под систему

description.p: Runs on the open psiphon-tunnel-core engine (GPLv3) and uses the same server network as NextVPN for Windows. NextVPN is an independent application and is not affiliated with Psiphon Inc.
Работает на открытом движке psiphon-tunnel-core (GPLv3) и использует ту же сеть серверов, что и NextVPN для Windows. NextVPN — независимое приложение, не связанное с Psiphon Inc.

Closing the window quits the app, as on any other desktop program; keeping it in the tray is a setting. Settings and the log say whether the window is drawn with the graphics card, and what helps on NixOS when it is not. The status pill in the header is gone.
VPN mode: every program, game and terminal goes through the tunnel, DNS included, on any desktop, Hyprland and other window managers too. NetworkManager sets the interface up; no password is asked.
The engine is built from the newest upstream psiphon-tunnel-core. The tray icon shows on quickshell-based shells such as caelestia, and upstream notices no longer appear as banners.
First release for Linux: GTK 4 and libadwaita, the same servers and features as the Windows build.
